Test Steps: Verify employee can apply for leave with all valid mandatory fields
Test Data: 1. Log in as Employee 2. Navigate to HRMS > Leave 3. Click 'Apply Leave' 4. Select Leave Type, Start Date, End Date, Reason 5. Click 'Submit'
Type of Test cases: Type: Casual, Start: Today+1, End: Today+3
Date of execution: Leave request should be submitted successfully with 'Pending' status.

Test Steps: Verify validation when mandatory fields are left blank
Test Data: 1. Click 'Apply Leave' 2. Leave 'Leave Type' and 'Start Date' blank 3. Click 'Submit'
Date of execution: System should display validation errors for required fields.

Test Steps: Verify Date validation (End Date < Start Date)
Test Data: 1. Click 'Apply Leave' 2. Select Start Date 3. Select End Date earlier than Start Date 4. Submit
Date of execution: System should throw validation error preventing submission.

Test Steps: Verify Date validation (Overlapping leaves)
Test Data: 1. Apply for leave from 10th to 15th 2. Apply for another leave from 12th to 14th
Date of execution: System should show error 'Leave request already exists for these dates'.

Test Steps: Verify applying for leave exceeding available balance
Test Data: 1. Check available Casual Leave (e.g. 5 days) 2. Apply for Casual Leave for 10 days
Date of execution: System should show error 'Insufficient leave balance'.

Test Steps: Verify Half-Day leave functionality
Test Data: 1. Click 'Apply Leave' 2. Select 'Half Day' checkbox 3. Select Date 4. Submit
Date of execution: System should deduct only 0.5 days from the leave balance.

Test Steps: Verify Half-Day validation across multiple days
Test Data: 1. Select 'Half Day' 2. Choose Start Date and End Date as different days
Date of execution: System should restrict Half-Day option to a single specific date only.

Test Steps: Verify applying for retrospective leave (Past dates)
Test Data: 1. Select Start Date in the past (e.g., last week) 2. Submit
Date of execution: Depending on policy, system should block or flag for special approval.

Test Steps: Verify Employee can view their own leave history
Test Data: 1. Log in as Employee 2. Navigate to HRMS > Leave
Date of execution: Table should list all past and current leave requests made by the employee.

Test Steps: Verify filtering leave history by Status
Test Data: 1. Select 'Approved' from Status dropdown filter
Date of execution: Only approved leaves should be displayed in the list.

Test Steps: Verify Leave Balance widget is visible and accurate
Test Data: 1. Go to Leave Dashboard 2. Check the Leave Balances cards (Sick, Casual, Earned)
Date of execution: Widgets should display exact remaining balances matching DB records.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can manually allocate leaves to an employee
Test Data: 1. Log in as Admin 2. Go to Leave Balances 3. Select Employee 4. Add +5 to Sick Leave
Date of execution: Employee's Sick leave balance should increase by 5.

Test Steps: Verify Admin cannot set negative leave balance
Test Data: 1. Admin selects Employee 2. Enters -10 in Leave balance field
Date of execution: System should reject negative allocation amounts.

Test Steps: Verify Manager/Admin can view all pending leave requests
Test Data: 1. Log in as Admin 2. Go to Leave Approvals
Date of execution: List should show all 'Pending' leaves from employees.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can approve a pending leave
Test Data: 1. Click 'Approve' on a pending request
Date of execution: Status changes to Approved, and employee's leave balance is deducted.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can reject a pending leave
Test Data: 1. Click 'Reject' on a pending request 2. Add reason for rejection
Date of execution: Status changes to Rejected, leave balance is NOT deducted.

Test Steps: Verify employee is notified on leave status change
Test Data: 1. Admin approves leave 2. Check employee's email/notification bell
Date of execution: Employee receives a notification that their leave was approved.

Test Steps: Verify Employee cannot approve their own leave
Test Data: 1. Log in as Employee 2. Inspect URL or attempt to call approval API directly
Date of execution: System should return '403 Forbidden' or Access Denied.

Test Steps: Verify Employee can cancel a Pending leave
Test Data: 1. Log in as Employee 2. Find a Pending leave 3. Click 'Cancel'
Date of execution: Leave request status updates to 'Cancelled'.

Test Steps: Verify Employee can cancel an Approved leave (before start date)
Test Data: 1. Find an Approved leave (future date) 2. Click 'Cancel'
Date of execution: Status changes to 'Cancelled', and deducted leave balance is refunded/added back.

Test Steps: Verify validation when cancelling a Rejected leave
Test Data: 1. Find a Rejected leave 2. Attempt to cancel
Date of execution: Cancel button should be disabled or action rejected by system.

Test Steps: Verify validation when cancelling a leave that has already passed
Test Data: 1. Find an Approved leave (past date) 2. Attempt to cancel
Date of execution: System should prevent cancellation of historical leave records.

Test Steps: Verify uploading a valid medical certificate for Sick Leave
Test Data: 1. Apply for Sick Leave > 3 days 2. Upload a 1MB PDF medical certificate 3. Submit
Date of execution: Leave request submitted successfully with attachment accessible to Admin.

Test Steps: Verify validation when uploading executable file (.exe)
Test Data: 1. Apply for Sick Leave 2. Upload a malicious .exe file
Date of execution: System should reject file upload with 'Invalid file format' error.

Test Steps: Verify validation when attachment exceeds size limit
Test Data: 1. Upload a 25MB PDF file
Date of execution: System should reject upload with 'File size exceeds maximum limit' error.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can download/view attached medical certificate
Test Data: 1. Admin opens the leave request 2. Clicks on the attachment link
Date of execution: File should download or open correctly in the browser.

Test Steps: Verify SQL Injection in Leave Reason field
Test Data: 1. Apply for leave 2. Enter SQL payload in Reason field
Date of execution: System should sanitize input and save as plain text without DB errors.

Test Steps: Verify XSS vulnerability in Leave Reason field
Test Data: 1. Apply for leave 2. Enter <script>alert(1)</script> in Reason 3. Admin views it
Date of execution: Script should not execute when viewed by Admin; should render as safe text.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can create a new Leave Type
Test Data: 1. Admin goes to Leave Settings 2. Add 'Maternity Leave' with 180 days allocation
Date of execution: New leave type should be available in dropdown for eligible employees.

Test Steps: Verify Employee cannot apply for deactivated Leave Type
Test Data: 1. Admin deactivates 'Study Leave' 2. Employee tries to apply for it
Date of execution: Study Leave should not appear in the employee's dropdown menu.
